provider_scope_organization_id_check.name: provider_scope_organization_id_check
provider_scope_organization_id_check.value: ("provider"."scope" = 'project' AND "provider"."organization_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("provider"."scope" = 'platform' AND "provider"."organization_id" IS NULL)

email_delivery_event_sender_kind_check.name: email_delivery_event_sender_kind_check
email_delivery_event_sender_kind_check.value: ("email_delivery_event"."custom_domain_id" IS NOT NULL) <> ("email_delivery_event"."sandbox_domain_id" IS NOT NULL)

email_delivery_body_present_check.name: email_delivery_body_present_check
email_delivery_body_present_check.value: "email_delivery"."html" IS NOT NULL OR "email_delivery"."text" IS NOT NULL

email_delivery_sender_kind_check.name: email_delivery_sender_kind_check
email_delivery_sender_kind_check.value: ("email_delivery"."custom_domain_id" IS NOT NULL) <> ("email_delivery"."sandbox_domain_id" IS NOT NULL)

email_dns_record_scope_check.name: email_dns_record_scope_check
email_dns_record_scope_check.value: ("email_dns_record"."role" = 'shared' AND "email_dns_record"."custom_domain_id" IS NULL AND "email_dns_record"."sandbox_domain_id" IS NULL) OR ("email_dns_record"."role" <> 'shared' AND (("email_dns_record"."custom_domain_id" IS NOT NULL) <> ("email_dns_record"."sandbox_domain_id" IS NOT NULL)))

email_domain_provider_identity_domain_ki.name: email_domain_provider_identity_domain_kind_check
email_domain_provider_identity_domain_ki.value: ("email_domain_provider_identity"."custom_domain_id" IS NOT NULL) <> ("email_domain_provider_identity"."sandbox_domain_id" IS NOT NULL)

template_channel_variant_engine_payload_.name: template_channel_variant_engine_payload_check
template_channel_variant_engine_payload_.value:
(
        "template_channel_variant"."engine" = 'primitive'
        AND "template_channel_variant"."workspace_entry_id" IS NULL
        AND "template_channel_variant"."content" IS NOT NULL
      ) OR (
        "template_channel_variant"."engine" = 'reactEmail'
        AND "template_channel_variant"."variables" IS NULL
        AND "template_channel_variant"."content" IS NOT NULL
        AND coalesce("template_channel_variant"."content"->>'subject', '') <> ''
      )

templating_workspace_source_fields_check.name: templating_workspace_source_fields_check
templating_workspace_source_fields_check.value:
(
        "templating_workspace"."source" = 'hosted'
        AND "templating_workspace"."github_repository" IS NULL
        AND "templating_workspace"."github_track_branch" IS NULL
      ) OR (
        "templating_workspace"."source" = 'github'
        AND "templating_workspace"."github_repository" IS NOT NULL
        AND "templating_workspace"."github_track_branch" IS NOT NULL
      )
